pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(Amount) AS total_amount FROM donations), repeat AS (SELECT Donor, SUM(Amount) AS repeat_amount FROM donations GROUP BY Donor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), repeat_total AS (SELECT SUM(repeat_amount) AS repeat_amount FROM repeat), repeat_count AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_donor_count FROM repeat) SELECT (repeat_total.repeat_amount / NULLIF(NULLIF(total.total_amount, 0), 0)) * 100 AS percent_repeat, repeat_count.repeat_donor_count FROM total CROSS JOIN repeat_total CROSS JOIN repeat_count

CURRENT QUESTION:
what percent of total donation value comes from people who gave more than once, and how many repeat donors are there
attempts.response:
WITH total AS (
  SELECT SUM(Amount) AS total_amount
  FROM donations
),
repeat AS (
  SELECT Donor, SUM(Amount) AS repeat_amount
  FROM donations
  GROUP BY Donor
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
repeat_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(repeat_amount) AS repeat_amount
  FROM repeat
),
repeat_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_donor_count
  FROM repeat
)
SELECT
  (repeat_total.repeat_amount / NULLIF(total.total_amount, 0)) * 100 AS percent_repeat,
  repeat_count.repeat_donor_count
FROM total, repeat_total, repeat_count;
